svg.title: Reading a spine X-ray: after the ABCS sweep, each abnormality has its view, its sign and what it means next: fracture (stable or unstable), facet dislocation, pars defect and spondylolisthesis, scoliosis by Cobb angle, ankylosing spondylitis and sacroiliitis, and prevertebral soft-tissue swelling; normal variants are not disease

svg.text: • limbus vertebra: triangle of bone at the front-top corner (unfused ring apophysis), teens, often L4: NOT a fracture

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Schmorl's nodes: endplate dents, usually incidental

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • cervical rib off C7 (C7 transverse process over ~2–2.5 cm): neck pain, arm pain if it presses the neurovascular bundle

svg.text: • atlantodental interval: under 3 mm adults, under 5 mm children (more = instability)
